products to shelves nationwide. From our Omaha, Nebraska facility, we manage warehousing and
fulfillment to ensure products arrive where they’re needed, when they’re needed.

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]
Toggle autoplay
[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues.

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]
Toggle autoplay
[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues. 

[Learn More][118]

## AKC Canine Health Foundation

## AKC Canine Health Foundation

The AKC Canine Health Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to the prevention and
treatment of diseases in all dogs. Since 1995, we’ve been awarding grants to scientists and
professionals to advance canine health research, while providing professional information and
resources for today’s dog owner.

[Learn About AKC Canine Health Foundation][46]

## Rescue Network

## Rescue Network

The AKC Rescue Network is the largest network of dog rescue groups in the U.S., with more than 450
groups providing fostering and rehabilitation services.

[Learn About AKC Rescue Network][47]

## AKC Reunite

## AKC Reunite

AKC Reunite is North America’s largest not-for-profit pet ID and recovery service, providing
microchipping and ID services as well as a national recovery database to safely return dogs home
should they get lost and, through AKC Pet Disaster Relief, helping local Emergency Management to
provide animal care services immediately following disasters.

[Learn About AKC Reunite][48]

## AKC Humane Fund

## AKC Humane Fund

The AKC Humane Fund offers grants and resources to pet-related organizations across the nation for
educating the public about responsible dog ownership.

[Learn About AKC Humane Fund][49]

## Museum of the Dog

## Museum of the Dog

The AKC Museum of the Dog is dedicated to the collection, preservation, exhibition, and
interpretation of the art, artifacts and literature of the dog for the purposes of education,
historical perspective, aesthetic enjoyment and in order to enhance the appreciation for and
knowledge of the significance of the dog and the human/canine relationship.

[Learn About AKC Museum of the Dog][50]

## Protecting Your Rights

## Protecting Your Rights

The AKC Government Relations Department (GR) leads advocacy and legislative efforts to protect the
rights of all dog owners, promote responsible dog ownership and ensure that laws governing dog
ownership and breeding are reasonable, enforceable and non-discriminatory. AKC GR monitors and
addresses canine legislation that impacts dog ownership, and is pleased to offer a wide range of
educational materials, policy resources and assistance to dog owners, club/community leaders and
policymakers alike.

[Learn About AKC Government Relations][51]

Dog shows (officially conformation) may look like beauty pageants, but they’re not. Dogs aren’t
compared against each other; they’re compared against the standards of their breed.

An exhilarating way to exercise with your dog, Agility is a fast-paced obstacle course with tunnels,
hurdles, and other challenges that your dog completes as quickly as possible.
][53]

In Rally, you and your dog navigate a course, side-by-side, through 10-20 different exercises and,
although it’s timed, it's more about proving excellent behavior and teamwork than speed.
][54]
[

### Fast CAT

This fast-paced event features one dog running at a time, with their speed clocked and converted to
MPH. Any dog over 12 months of age that are registered or enrolled with the AKC can participate.
][55]
[

This entirely virtual program tests for the 10 necessary skills that well-mannered dogs need in the
home setting! VHM gets you started on practical skills needed before your first training class.

In AKC Scent Work, the handler guides the dog through a set search area to find specific odors that

Your dog’s natural ability to recognize and follow a scent is on full display in AKC Tracking
events.

around a field.
][60]
[

Open to small terriers and Dachshunds, Earthdog tests are non-competitive and assess your dog’s
abilities for seeking and locating prey underground.

Since 1924, these competitions give your pointing breed a chance to show how fast he can run and his
keen desire to hunt for and find game.
][62]
[

### Hunting

Hunting tests are designed to test a dog's ability to work with their human hunting companion in a

## with the ASPCA®

As a strategic partner of the ASPCA® since 2006, we’re committed to providing reliable, affordable,
and trustworthy coverage so our pets can live happier, healthier, longer lives.

## Pet plans that work

Explore flexible coverage, customizable to you

Most Popular Plan

### Complete Coverage^{SM}

Coverage that offers things you’d want and expect for your pet when they’re hurt or sick and covers
exam fees and costs of diagnostics and treatment for accidents, illnesses, hereditary conditions,
and behavioral issues.

[See Pricing][79]

#### Accidents

Injuries including broken paws and swallowed objects

#### Hereditary Conditions

Inherited conditions such as kidney or heart disease

#### Illnesses

Includes minor illnesses to serious diseases, like cancer

#### [Behavioral Issues][80]

Issues like destructive scratching or excessive vocalization

#### [Dental Disease][81]

Covers dental diseases like gingivitis, and tooth extractions for dental accidents.

#### Alternative Therapies

Treatments for covered conditions like acupuncture, chiropractic care, and hydrotherapy

## Low Cost. Big Heart.

Emancipet is a nonprofit organization on a mission to make veterinary care affordable and accessible
to everyone.

[ Find a Clinic ][80]

### This Holiday Season, Join Us in Making Veterinary Care Affordable & Accessible

[ Donate Today ][82]

### About Us

Pets are family. They bring joy and unconditional love to our lives, and they deserve a lifetime of
health and well-being. Emancipet is a nonprofit organization that operates low-cost veterinary
clinics in neighborhoods across the country to ensure all pet families in need have access to
affordable veterinary care for their pets.

[ Learn More ][83]

### Find Your Clinic

Looking for high-quality care for your pet? Emancipet provides healthy pet services and more at
low-cost vet clinics in Houston, Austin, Killeen, and Central Texas as well as Philadelphia,
Pennsylvania.
[ Find Care Near You ][84]

### Services

Our experienced team of licensed veterinarians and trained technicians help your pets stay healthy,
happy, and at home with their favorite people. Each clinic offers a unique set of services based on
the needs of their local communities.

## FAQ'S About Flea Control in Holder

How can I tell if my home has a flea or tick problem in Holder?

Fleas in Holder homes are identified by pets scratching constantly, tiny jumping insects on carpet
or furniture, and bite clusters on ankles. Ticks are found by checking pets after outdoor time or
finding attached ticks on family members. Both signs point to an environmental infestation requiring
treatment.

Are flea and tick treatments safe for children and pets in Holder?

Yes, flea and tick treatments applied in Holder homes use pet and child-safe products when correctly
applied. Technicians provide preparation checklists and re-entry times before treatment begins. Pets
should be kept off treated surfaces until fully dry to ensure complete safety throughout the home.

How long does it take to get rid of fleas and ticks in Holder?

Flea elimination in Holder shows noticeable reduction within 3 to 5 days after treatment. Full
clearance including hatching eggs takes 2 to 3 weeks. Tick treatments for outdoor zones take effect
within 24 to 48 hours. A follow-up visit confirms complete clearance for both pest types.

What’s the cost of flea and tick control services in Holder?

Flea and tick control in Holder typically ranges from $150 to $350 for indoor residential treatment.
Outdoor yard tick treatment is priced separately between $100 and $250 depending on yard size.
Combined indoor and outdoor packages offer better overall value for properties with active pet use.

## Trusted Veterinarian Care in the Pacific Northwest

Good Neighbor Vet proudly serves Oregon and Washington. We take pride in providing our patients with
the best care, doing everything in our hands for the health and safety of your four-legged friends.
We work to make sure your pet is the healthiest they can be, and to reciprocate the unconditional
love they give to us. 
Pets should remain out of the service line until they see the veterinarian. Cats should be in a
carrier and dogs on a leash ahead of your visit with us.

## Why Pet Owners Trust Our Veterinarians

Owners trust us, pets love us.
**Joy Broadnax**
My pets are safe and sound after they receive all required vaccines and positive results from the
heartworm test. They also  have meds for  allergies. In the summer my dog is allergic to the
fertilizer put on grass at the parks in the summer. It makes him itch. I can finally REST now. Thank
you all.
**William**
I feel very comfortable and know my pets needs and health are  priority here.
**Linda Durham**
They were efficient and well organized. They cared about my dogs comfort through the whole process.
It didn't break the bank for everything that she needed!!!!! They even have online orders for
refills on her flea meds. I love them all and will continue to be a customer!!!
**Stephen Woolf**
They got us in quick even with limited staff. They were very sweet to my doggo and were very gentle.
**Ashley Hayes**
First come first served was fair, efficient and well organized. Vets and techs were friendly and
kind to my babies. Also, I needed a copy of my dogs last vaccinations after a move and the
communication via their site was fast and easy.
**Kathy**
Excellent service... very caring veterinarian... and staff..
**Tamara Lattion**
Kind and efficient excellent prices.
**Tonya Z**
If you go to one of their clinics, make sure you go there early. Great service the staff is very
caring and they are very knowledgeable. I highly recommend them.
**Chrys Tea**
They are really great with our toy poodle puppy. They always answer all the questions we have and
offer great advice.
**Alberto Froylan**
Friendly and excellent service!!!

# Good Neighbor Vet
# Trusted Veterinarian & Pet Care

[Find your Clinic][27]

## Trusted Veterinarian Care in the Pacific Northwest

Good Neighbor Vet proudly serves Oregon and Washington. We take pride in providing our patients with
the best care, doing everything in our hands for the health and safety of your four-legged friends.
We work to make sure your pet is the healthiest they can be, and to reciprocate the unconditional
love they give to us. 
Pets should remain out of the service line until they see the veterinarian. Cats should be in a
carrier and dogs on a leash ahead of your visit with us.

## Why Pet Owners Trust Our Veterinarians

Owners trust us, pets love us.
**Joy Broadnax**
My pets are safe and sound after they receive all required vaccines and positive results from the
heartworm test. They also  have meds for  allergies. In the summer my dog is allergic to the
fertilizer put on grass at the parks in the summer. It makes him itch. I can finally REST now. Thank
you all.
**William**
I feel very comfortable and know my pets needs and health are  priority here.
**Linda Durham**
They were efficient and well organized. They cared about my dogs comfort through the whole process.
It didn't break the bank for everything that she needed!!!!! They even have online orders for
refills on her flea meds. I love them all and will continue to be a customer!!!
**Stephen Woolf**
They got us in quick even with limited staff. They were very sweet to my doggo and were very gentle.
**Ashley Hayes**
First come first served was fair, efficient and well organized. Vets and techs were friendly and
kind to my babies. Also, I needed a copy of my dogs last vaccinations after a move and the
communication via their site was fast and easy.
**Kathy**
Excellent service... very caring veterinarian... and staff..
**Tamara Lattion**
Kind and efficient excellent prices.
**Tonya Z**
If you go to one of their clinics, make sure you go there early. Great service the staff is very
caring and they are very knowledgeable. I highly recommend them.
**Chrys Tea**
They are really great with our toy poodle puppy. They always answer all the questions we have and
offer great advice.
**Alberto Froylan**
Friendly and excellent service!!!

Our vision:

A world without heartworms.

[Visit our Resource Center ][48]

### More than a million pets in the U.S. have heartworms. But heartworm disease is preventable.

True to its mission of leading the veterinary profession and public in understanding heartworm
disease, the American Heartworm Society sponsors heartworm education and research.

[Find Heartworm Resources Here ][49]
[[Puppy and kitten with hearts]][50]

### [Support the AHS mission][51]

Heartworm disease can be a devastating disease—and it’s also one of the most preventable diseases in
pets. You can help the American Heartworm Society expand our educational mission by supporting us in
one of the following ways:
* **Become a **[**member**.][52] AHS members receive the AHS Bulletin, participate in exclusive

Hi there, I’m Nancy, a.k.a. Seal Mom.

I’m an avid hiker and backpacker in western North Carolina. I’m also a search and rescue team member
in Haywood County, home to Shining Rock Wilderness and a sizable portion of Great Smoky Mountains
National Park.

I created this website to pay it forward to the hiking community by providing:
* **Outdoor education** to keep hikers safe and prepared in the backcountry.  If you read one post
  at all on my blog, please make sure it’s this one:  [What Search and Rescue Teams Want Every Hiker
  to Know .][59]
* **Solid preparedness advice for new hikers and intel on quality gear deals **in my popular
  [Facebook group][60].
* **Trail journals** of the hikes I take locally and afar.

Take a look around and I hope you find the information useful and engaging! And [head here][61] if
you’d like to know a little more about my background.

Happy Trails,

Nancy

Mid-South TN for over 25 years, your proud local pest control leaders at Inman-Murphy, Inc. work
diligently to keep homes and businesses in our area pest-free and our customers worry-free.

Founded in 1999, Inman-Murphy, Inc. has spent over 25 years innovating in technology and practices
to protect both residential and commercial properties from regional pests. We center efficient
prevention and removal in all of our services.

When it comes to living and working pest-free, working with Inman-Murphy, Inc. is your best bet.

and ourselves.

controlling local pest.

We use environmentally-sensitive products and services that are safe for your family, pets, and
property.

keep homes protected from seasonal pests. We understand that your home is your biggest investment,
so we commit ourselves to delivering extermination services that protect your home from pests
year-round.

pest prevention, removal, exclusion, and more. **Our state-certified and licensed pest control

exterminators they can be. We know what you’re dealing with because this is our home, too!**

We know that having pest infestation in your home can be stressful or even dangerous. Having served
Mid-South TN for over 25 years, your proud local pest control leaders at Inman-Murphy, Inc. work
diligently to keep homes and businesses in our area pest-free and our customers worry-free.

Founded in 1999, Inman-Murphy, Inc. has spent over 25 years innovating in technology and practices
to protect both residential and commercial properties from regional pests. We center efficient
prevention and removal in all of our services.

When it comes to living and working pest-free, working with Inman-Murphy, Inc. is your best bet.

### Promised Satisfaction

We ensure that you are 100% satisfied with your pest control service. It is our commitment to you
and ourselves.

### Local Exterminators

You can expect a treatment conducted by local exterminators with experience analyzing and
controlling local pest.

### Safety First

We use environmentally-sensitive products and services that are safe for your family, pets, and
property.

### Pest Control **For Your Home**

In over 25 years of experience, we’ve learned that a year-round pest control service is essential to
keep homes protected from seasonal pests. We understand that your home is your biggest investment,
so we commit ourselves to delivering extermination services that protect your home from pests
year-round. 

We keep homes in Mid-South TN safe through continual innovation in our practices and approaches to
pest prevention, removal, exclusion, and more. **Our state-certified and licensed pest control
specialists stay up to date on the developing pest environment in Mid-South TN to be the best local
exterminators they can be. We know what you’re dealing with because this is our home, too!**

## Local. **Independent**. Woman-Owned.

At [Love City Vet][34] we enhance the lives of our team, pets, and the community by delivering the
best veterinary experience for all.

[Our Story][35]

## **Two Locations**. One Love.

[South Philly][36][Northern Liberties][37]

## *Free On-Site Parking At Both*

## Our Core Values

At **Love** City Vet our core values guide us in all we do.

LEAD with compassion
OFFER modern and equitable vet care
VALUE our community
EMPOWER our team
[Learn More][38]
[Schedule a Visit][39]

## Committed To Our Amazing Team

We believe our[ team members][40] are the heart of Love City Vet and deserve the best possible
working environment. We’re committed to empowering our veterinary staff and providing them with the
resources they need to succeed. In turn, our team is here for you and your pet when needed most.

[Meet the team][41]
[Schedule a Visit][42]

## Committed To Our Amazing Team

We believe our[ team members][43] are the heart of Love City Vet and deserve the best possible
working environment. We’re committed to empowering our veterinary staff and providing them with the
resources they need to succeed. In turn, our team is here for you and your pet when needed most.

[Meet the team][44]
[Schedule a Visit][45]


## Providing **Exceptional Care** To Our Community

We offer modern and top-of-the-line care supported by our high-tech veterinary equipment and medical
software. The future of neighborhood vet care has never looked so bright as when you’re with [Love
City Vet][46]. Communication is important to us and that’s why we’re accessible via text, email, and
phone as well as our Pet Portal.

We also know that veterinary care can be expensive. **That is why at Love City Vet we’re transparent
about our [pricing][47] and offer a variety of [payment options][48] so that all of our clients can
afford the best veterinary care for their pets.**

Additionally, [Fran’s Fund][49] was established to collect donations and help support the care of
underserved pets in our community.

## Our Services

#### Pet Wellness Exams

We believe annual wellness care is imperative to keeping your pet happy and healthy! Your pet’s
health is important and preventive care is necessary.

#### Pet Dentistry

Just as it’s important for you to see a dentist regularly, it’s important for dogs and cats as well.
Your pet’s oral health is directly connected to their overall health.

#### Pet Surgery

Our experienced veterinarians provide many surgical services at our clinic, ranging from routine to
advanced procedures at Love City Vet.

#### Pet Sick Appointments

We offer sick appointments because we understand that when your pet is sick, you want nothing more
than to see them healthy and happy again.

#### Senior Animal Care

Our team is super passionate about senior animal care thus ensuring your pet enjoys their golden
years.

#### Pet End of Life Care

We will be able to help you assess your pet’s quality of life and determine whether end-of-life care
is the best option for you and your beloved pet.

[View All Services][50]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

## Our **Logo’s** Story

Love City Vet’s logo is a tribute to Dr. Lenahen’s previous senior pets, Monroe and Josephine.
Josephine and Monroe would sit together in the wagon as they were wheeled around Philadelphia with
passerbyers eager to stop and say hi to the senior pair.

At Love City Vet, pets of all ages and people of all backgrounds are welcome -so hop in the wagon!

[Learn More][51]

We proudly serve the pets of South Philadelphia, Northern Liberties, and beyond. You may request an

# Delivering the best veterinary experience for our team, pets, and the community.

## Local. **Independent**. Woman-Owned.

At [Love City Vet][34] we enhance the lives of our team, pets, and the community by delivering the
best veterinary experience for all.

[Our Story][35]

## **Two Locations**. One Love.

[South Philly][36][Northern Liberties][37]

## *Free On-Site Parking At Both*

## Our Core Values

At **Love** City Vet our core values guide us in all we do.

LEAD with compassion
OFFER modern and equitable vet care
VALUE our community
EMPOWER our team
[Learn More][38]
[Schedule a Visit][39]

## Committed To Our Amazing Team

We believe our[ team members][40] are the heart of Love City Vet and deserve the best possible
working environment. We’re committed to empowering our veterinary staff and providing them with the
resources they need to succeed. In turn, our team is here for you and your pet when needed most.

[Meet the team][41]
[Schedule a Visit][42]

## Committed To Our Amazing Team

We believe our[ team members][43] are the heart of Love City Vet and deserve the best possible
working environment. We’re committed to empowering our veterinary staff and providing them with the
resources they need to succeed. In turn, our team is here for you and your pet when needed most.

[Meet the team][44]
[Schedule a Visit][45]


## Providing **Exceptional Care** To Our Community

We offer modern and top-of-the-line care supported by our high-tech veterinary equipment and medical
software. The future of neighborhood vet care has never looked so bright as when you’re with [Love
City Vet][46]. Communication is important to us and that’s why we’re accessible via text, email, and
phone as well as our Pet Portal.

We also know that veterinary care can be expensive. **That is why at Love City Vet we’re transparent
about our [pricing][47] and offer a variety of [payment options][48] so that all of our clients can
afford the best veterinary care for their pets.**

Additionally, [Fran’s Fund][49] was established to collect donations and help support the care of
underserved pets in our community.

## Our Services

#### Pet Wellness Exams

We believe annual wellness care is imperative to keeping your pet happy and healthy! Your pet’s
health is important and preventive care is necessary.

#### Pet Dentistry

Just as it’s important for you to see a dentist regularly, it’s important for dogs and cats as well.
Your pet’s oral health is directly connected to their overall health.

#### Pet Surgery

Our experienced veterinarians provide many surgical services at our clinic, ranging from routine to
advanced procedures at Love City Vet.

#### Pet Sick Appointments

We offer sick appointments because we understand that when your pet is sick, you want nothing more
than to see them healthy and happy again.

#### Senior Animal Care

Our team is super passionate about senior animal care thus ensuring your pet enjoys their golden
years.

#### Pet End of Life Care

We will be able to help you assess your pet’s quality of life and determine whether end-of-life care
is the best option for you and your beloved pet.

[View All Services][50]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

## Our **Logo’s** Story

Love City Vet’s logo is a tribute to Dr. Lenahen’s previous senior pets, Monroe and Josephine.
Josephine and Monroe would sit together in the wagon as they were wheeled around Philadelphia with
passerbyers eager to stop and say hi to the senior pair.

At Love City Vet, pets of all ages and people of all backgrounds are welcome -so hop in the wagon!

[Learn More][51]

## Ready to hop in the wagon?

We proudly serve the pets of South Philadelphia, Northern Liberties, and beyond. You may request an
appointment by clicking the button below.

[Book Appointment][52]
Book your pet’s first exam today.

# 2025 Lyme Disease Awareness Month

Join with LymeDisease.org to find better ways to prevent and treat tick-borne diseases.

[Support LymeDisease.org][136][Get Involved][137]
How Your Support **Makes a Difference**


LymeDisease.org is the largest communications network in Lyme disease. Our website draws millions of
unique visitors a year providing up-to-date and timely news and Lyme disease education.


We conduct the largest research study of Lyme disease through our patient registry and research
platform, MyLymeData. MyLymeData empowers patients to use their data to drive change.


Grass roots advocacy representing the patient for legislative, treatment and insurance changes. We
represent hundreds of thousands of patients and provide them with the tools essential to
empowerment.


The Lyme Times connects you to trustworthy information on critical research, events and treatment
for Lyme disease and other tick-borne diseases.


Weekly e-newsletter and social media such as FaceBook, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest and Instagram
keep the public informed on timely topics and events facing the patient population.

Over 18,000 patients have enrolled in MyLymeData, pooling their health history, symptoms, and

We aim to help you visualize the information from MyLymeData in a way that makes it more useful to

How Your Support **Makes a Difference**


LymeDisease.org is the largest communications network in Lyme disease. Our website draws millions of
unique visitors a year providing up-to-date and timely news and Lyme disease education.


We conduct the largest research study of Lyme disease through our patient registry and research
platform, MyLymeData. MyLymeData empowers patients to use their data to drive change.


Grass roots advocacy representing the patient for legislative, treatment and insurance changes. We
represent hundreds of thousands of patients and provide them with the tools essential to
empowerment.


The Lyme Times connects you to trustworthy information on critical research, events and treatment
for Lyme disease and other tick-borne diseases.


Weekly e-newsletter and social media such as FaceBook, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest and Instagram
keep the public informed on timely topics and events facing the patient population.

#### BRAVECTO® Quantum

[[icon: arrow-right]Read more][272]

cattle

#### Merck Animal Health Works for Cow-Calf & Stocker Operations

We know operations like yours often deal with a lot of unknowns. While we may not be able to help
you control the weather, we can help you bring strong, heavy, uniform herds to market.

[[icon: arrow-right]Read more][274]
[[icon: arrow-right]][275]

COMPANION ANIMAL

#### Mometamax Single™

Discover a convenient single-dose, in-clinic treatment for canine otitis externa. With a novel
combination of active ingredients, this treatment provides the best of 3 worlds.

[[icon: arrow-right]Read more][276]
[[icon: arrow-right]][277]

CATTLE

#### Merck Animal Health Works for Dairies

We know there are many things that keep dairy producers up at night – but accessing high quality
products shouldn’t be one of them. At Merck Animal Health, we’re here to help you do just that, with
the support you want and the products you need to efficiently run your dairy and maintain a healthy
milk supply.

[[icon: arrow-right]Read more][278]
[[icon: arrow-right]][279]

#### Veterinary Wellbeing and Scholarship

Merck Animal Health is committed to the veterinary profession. We hope to bring critical awareness
and solutions to this important matter to better meet veterinarians’ needs.

[[icon: arrow-right]Read more][280]

Our customers have always known that they can depend on Merck Animal Health for more than just
medicines. They count on Merck Animal Health for information, technologies and veterinary services
that truly advance animal healthcare. It is our heritage and our mission.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# Professional Lawn Care Services in Omaha, NE

[Paradise Lawns technician applying organic granular fertilizer to a residential lawn in Omaha using
a walk-behind spreader under overcast skies.]
[Top Rated Local award winner badge for Omaha lawn care]

Healthy lawns in Omaha require more than routine treatments. Between compacted clay soil, extreme
seasonal swings, and aggressive weeds, turf in Eastern Nebraska needs a structured, professional
approach.

At Paradise Lawns, we specialize in organic-focused lawn care programs, while also offering
traditional fertilization options when appropriate. Every program is built around soil health,
proper timing, and long-term performance.

[**Get a Lawn Care Estimate**][17]


## Organic-First Lawn Care Built for Omaha Soil

Nebraska’s clay soil creates compaction, poor drainage, and shallow root systems. Without consistent
care, lawns struggle through heat, drought, and heavy traffic.

Our organic-focused approach prioritizes soil biology and long-term turf strength — because healthy
soil produces thicker, more resilient grass.

For homeowners who prefer a traditional fertilization program, we provide that option as well —
always structured around seasonal timing and measurable results.

We serve Omaha, Elkhorn, Bennington, Blair, Gretna, Papillion, La Vista, Bellevue, and surrounding
communities.


## **Our Lawn Care Services**


### Fertilization & Weed Control

Seasonal fertilization and weed control programs with both organic and traditional options. Designed
for consistent turf performance throughout the growing season.

[Learn more about Fertilization & Weed Control][18]


### Aeration & Soil Care

Core aeration, compost topdressing, and overseeding services that relieve compaction and strengthen
root systems.

[Learn more about Aeration & Soil Care][19]


### Flea & Tick Defense

Targeted lawn treatments to reduce fleas and ticks and create a more comfortable outdoor space for
your family and pets.

[Learn more about Flea & Tick Defense][20]


### Christmas Lighting

All-inclusive exterior roofline holiday lighting installation and service.

[Learn more about Christmas Lighting][21]


## A Better Approach to Lawn Care

In the past, achieving a thick, green lawn often meant relying heavily on harsh chemical
applications. Our organic-first philosophy focuses on building soil strength, improving root
development, and reducing unnecessary inputs.

The result is a lawn that performs better over time — and a program that many homeowners feel better
about using around their families and pets.

 

## Serving Omaha and Surrounding Areas

Paradise Lawns proudly serves homeowners throughout the Omaha metro area, including West Omaha,
Elkhorn, Bennington, Blair, Gretna, Papillion, La Vista, Bellevue, and nearby communities.


## Why Homeowners Choose Paradise Lawns

• Organic-focused lawn programs
• Structured seasonal treatment plans
• BeeSafe certified applicators
• Professional-grade equipment
• Responsive local service

We focus on long-term lawn stability — not short-term cosmetic fixes.



## Ready for a Healthier Lawn?

If you’re looking for professional lawn care services in Omaha with an organic-first philosophy and
structured seasonal programs, Paradise Lawns is ready to help.

[**Request a Lawn Estimate**][22]

# Home Page

Piney Mountain Foster Care is a small, all volunteer, non-profit skilled care facility located on 4
acres of mountainside property in Edwina Tennessee. We got our start in 2012 by caring for dogs
going through heart worm treatment.  We are NOT a public animal shelter and can not take owner
surrendered animals.

# Our Mission

Our primary mission is to help rescue dogs from kill shelters.  Many need health care.  Most need
training.  We offer medical rehabilitation and behavioral modification in a tranquil setting.

When adoptable, we work with and through our [**Canine Rescue** **Partners**][18] locally and around
the nation to find these dogs quality homes.

The secondary mission is to raise awareness and promote prevention of animal cruelty and to curb
rampant companion animal over-population by promoting low cost spay-neuter programs.

# Funding Foster Care

To keep the facility maintained and provide food and medical care to our residents, we depend on
[donors][19] like you.

**NOTE**: PMFC is an all-volunteer organization.
All money donated to ***Piney Mountain Foster Care, Inc.***
is used to provide care to the dogs, not salaries or benefits to humans.
PMFC is a [501(c)(3) Public Charity][20] EIN: 84-3593563

[Venmo][21]

# Other Ways to Help
* Explore [volunteer opportunities][22]
* Info on becoming a [Foster Home][23]
* Send us things from our Wish List on [Amazon.com][24]

# Current Residents

Most dogs get a page that offers photos and video of that dog interacting with people and other dogs
as well as descriptions of their personality, habits, and progress in training.  As adopter Debra
Sollitto told us, “I have read your blog about Julian many times.  It was posted by Meryl on the
***Fur Friends in Need***  Facebook page.  *That blog and the videos of Julian are the main reason
that we pursued this adoption*.  After I met Julian at the adoption event and saw those videos, I
knew that I *had to have* this dog”.

We encourage rescues taking our dogs to link to the page related to that dog and use it in finding
them a forever home.  Below are our current residents.  Former Fosters are on the [Foster Dogs of
the Past][25] page.

# Home Page

Piney Mountain Foster Care is a small, all volunteer, non-profit skilled care facility located on 4
acres of mountainside property in Edwina Tennessee. We got our start in 2012 by caring for dogs
going through heart worm treatment.  We are NOT a public animal shelter and can not take owner
surrendered animals.

# Our Mission

Our primary mission is to help rescue dogs from kill shelters.  Many need health care.  Most need
training.  We offer medical rehabilitation and behavioral modification in a tranquil setting.

When adoptable, we work with and through our [**Canine Rescue** **Partners**][18] locally and around
the nation to find these dogs quality homes.

The secondary mission is to raise awareness and promote prevention of animal cruelty and to curb
rampant companion animal over-population by promoting low cost spay-neuter programs.

# Funding Foster Care

To keep the facility maintained and provide food and medical care to our residents, we depend on
[donors][19] like you.

**NOTE**: PMFC is an all-volunteer organization.
All money donated to ***Piney Mountain Foster Care, Inc.***
is used to provide care to the dogs, not salaries or benefits to humans.
PMFC is a [501(c)(3) Public Charity][20] EIN: 84-3593563

# Current Residents

Most dogs get a page that offers photos and video of that dog interacting with people and other dogs
as well as descriptions of their personality, habits, and progress in training.  As adopter Debra
Sollitto told us, “I have read your blog about Julian many times.  It was posted by Meryl on the
***Fur Friends in Need***  Facebook page.  *That blog and the videos of Julian are the main reason
that we pursued this adoption*.  After I met Julian at the adoption event and saw those videos, I
knew that I *had to have* this dog”.

We encourage rescues taking our dogs to link to the page related to that dog and use it in finding
them a forever home.  Below are our current residents.  Former Fosters are on the [Foster Dogs of
the Past][25] page.

## Unleashing the Power of Pet Nutrition for 90+ Years

With a team of nearly 500 experts, we’re continuing to push pet care forward to help pets live even
better, longer lives. Feeding 100 million pets yearly, we cater to unique needs and life stages. 

Use our pet food finder tool to get recommendations.

[Find Ideal Pet Food][128]

## Redefining Quality Pet Food

[A nutritionist viewing food under a microscope in a lab]

### Expertly Crafted. Veterinarian Approved.

We work with a robust team of pet experts, including nutritionists and veterinarians, to develop
recipes and make breakthroughs.

[Meet Our Experts][129]
[Kibble in a bowl surrounded by a variety of dog food ingredients]

### Purposeful Ingredients. Responsibly Sourced.

Our ingredients are high quality and purposefully selected—whether it’s because they provide the
right nutrients or are full of flavor your pet loves.

[Explore Ingredients][130]
[A human evaluating different kibbles]

### Quality 100 Million Pets Count On

We feed 100 million pets every year. Which is why we make quality and safety our top priority,
conducting 100,000 quality checks a day.

[Learn More][131]

## Make Pet Parenthood More Rewarding with myPurina

Get rewarded for buying your pet’s favorite Purina products with the myPurina app. Learn more about
how it works, explore our latest offers and start earning points right away.

[Explore myPurina][132]

## Purina Has Something for Every Pet

## Explore Dog and Cat Brands

With countless household favorites, we have something for every pet's unique needs and life stage.

[Explore Dog Brands][133][Explore Cat Brands][134]

## Purina Cares Here

[Woman lying in bed and hugging yellow lab dog]

### Creating More Pet-Friendly Domestic Violence Shelters

We’re breaking down barriers to help keep pets and people together when they need each other most
through the Purple Leash Project.

[Get Involved][135]
[Forest view with Purina Cares Here overlay]

### Healthy Pets Need a Healthy Planet

Our commitment to helping pets thrive begins with the food in their bowl, but it doesn’t stop there.
It also means caring for the planet pets and people share.

[Learn More][136]
[A human watching their cat coming out of its cage walking towards a Purina bowl of food]

### Helping Pets Find Their People with Petfinder®

We believe pets and people are better together. Which is why we’ve made it easier than ever to find
the perfect new family member.

[Meet Adoptables[Open in new window]][137]

## The Latest News from Purina

[Person wearing Team USA soccer jersey with Australian Shepard dog]

### Purina is the Official Pet Care Partner of U.S. Soccer

As the first-ever Official Pet Care Partner, see how we’re supporting USMNT fans and furry teammates
alike all summer long.

[Learn More][138]
[A human putting down a bowl of Pro Plan for her dog]

### New Pet Food Labels

Pet food labels are changing to a new format to enhance transparency and more closely align with
human food labeling. Learn how to analyze them like a pro.

[Learn More][139]

Whether you need advice on nutrition, training or anything in-between, we’ve got you covered.
Explore content developed to help you and your pet live your best life together.

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

### How does Simplify handle my data?

We're internet users too and place a heavy emphasis and commitment to your privacy. First and

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

### What are common issues?

### How to maintenance a Sawyer filter?

Backwash your filter after each outing, when your flow rate begins to diminish, before prolonged
storage, and when you are ready to start using your filter again. Backwashing your filter after
storage is a great way to re-wet the filter fibers and restore the flow rate before use. We would
recommend sanitizing occasionally, depending on how often you use, or if your filter has picked up
any unpleasant smells or tastes as well as prior to storing.

If the filter is slow or blocked, soak the filter in hot water (not to exceed 135 F) for about an
hour to loosen up any residual particulate built up in the filter fibers and then backflush several
times with hot water as hard as possible. The trick to a successful backwashing is to be very
forceful with the process.

Water will always take the path of least resistance, so in order to fully flush out the filter and
restore its flow rate, make sure you are exerting as much pressure as you can, especially during the
first couple of passes. If your flow rate is slow, your water source might be mineral rich, so we
would suggest soaking it in plain white vinegar for an hour or more, and then repeating the process
with hot water backflushes.

### What are common issues?

### How to maintenance a Sawyer filter?

Backwash your filter after each outing, when your flow rate begins to diminish, before prolonged
storage, and when you are ready to start using your filter again. Backwashing your filter after
storage is a great way to re-wet the filter fibers and restore the flow rate before use. We would
recommend sanitizing occasionally, depending on how often you use, or if your filter has picked up
any unpleasant smells or tastes as well as prior to storing.

If the filter is slow or blocked, soak the filter in hot water (not to exceed 135 F) for about an
hour to loosen up any residual particulate built up in the filter fibers and then backflush several
times with hot water as hard as possible. The trick to a successful backwashing is to be very
forceful with the process.

Water will always take the path of least resistance, so in order to fully flush out the filter and
restore its flow rate, make sure you are exerting as much pressure as you can, especially during the
first couple of passes. If your flow rate is slow, your water source might be mineral rich, so we
would suggest soaking it in plain white vinegar for an hour or more, and then repeating the process
with hot water backflushes.
